about: sunrise-sunset.org gives sunrise, sunset and twilight times for any city. This CLI searches cities, fetches today's times, browses countries, regions and cities, reads monthly calendars and queries the public sunrise/sunset JSON API.

commands.summary: Search cities by name. Returns numeric city ids and labels; use the id with get-today-times.

params.name: q
params.description: City name or prefix to search for

commands.summary: Get today's and tomorrow's sunrise/sunset widget for a city, selected by numeric id. Returns JSON with pre-rendered HTML fragments.

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric city id from search-cities, e.g. 119890 = Paris, France

commands.summary: Get today's sunrise/sunset cards for the most-searched cities in the visitor's country (grid), or for the visitor's geolocated city (geo).

params.name: geo
params.description: 1 = return times for the city geolocated from the caller's IP

commands.summary: Public JSON API: sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length and twilight times for a latitude/longitude on one date or across a date range.

params.name: date
params.description: Single date, YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today). Do not combine with date_start/date_end.

params.name: date_start
params.description: Range start date, YYYY-MM-DD (use together with date_end)

params.name: date_end
params.description: Range end date, YYYY-MM-DD (use together with date_start)

commands.summary: Open a city or region page by country code and slug (e.g. fr/paris, jp/tokyo, jp/tokyo-prefecture). Returns the page heading, title and meta description.

params.name: country_code
params.description: Two-letter lowercase country code used in site URLs, e.g. fr, jp

params.name: slug
params.description: City or region slug, e.g. paris, tokyo, tokyo-prefecture

commands.summary: List all countries on the explore page. Each link leads to a country listing of regions and cities.
List the regions and cities for a country by its full-name slug (e.g. japan). Links point to /{cc}/{slug} pages usable with get-location-page.

params.name: country
params.description: Country name slug as used on the explore page, e.g. japan, france

commands.summary: Get the monthly sunrise/sunset calendar for a location by name. Returns one item per day with the date, sunrise and sunset text.

params.name: location
params.description: Location name as typed in the calendar search box, e.g. Tokyo

params.name: month
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format (defaults to the current month)
